## 2026/01/05

Prarthana Sanjeeva Reddy joins the lab as Lead Research Specialist. Welcome!

## 2025/10/16

 - We presented our [work on novel forms of CH point mutations](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.10.12.25337792v1) at ASHG 2025 (platform talk)
 - Our [work](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-64236-x) on 'driverless' CH is now up at Nature Communications 

## 2025/9/28

Xuebo Wang presented our work on using genomic foundation models to infer gene regulatory networks at the DOHG retreat.

## 2025/7/22

We preprinted our [new polygenic risk score method](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.07.21.25331918v1) (with April Kim and Alexis Battle). 

## 2025/2/7

We presented our work on gene regulatory network inference in CD4 T cells to the [ENCORE group](https://encore-group.emory.edu/encore-hosts-invited-seminar-with-joshua-weinstock-on-gene-regulatory-networks/). 

## 2024/11/7

We presented our work on [clonal hematopoiesis without known drivers](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.08.22.24312319v2) at ASHG24, which received
a reviewers' choice award (top 10% of poster abstracts).  

## 2024/10/11

Our work on inferring gene regulatory networks in CD4+ T cells is now online at [Cell Genomics](https://www.cell.com/cell-genomics/fulltext/S2666-979X(24)00290-8)!
